units.rawText: Although I'm always talking about space exploration... The truth is, I never managed to actually go to space before I came to Magrasea.

units.rawText: That's an accepted part of the real world, isn't it? Nobody's been able to travel into space any more.

units.rawText: But there are always people who harbor that hope in their hearts. Even if it's covered up by dark clouds, even if most people think it's a fantasy... That little point of light will always be there.

units.rawText: And that's the reason why I was born. All my training, all my sim practice... It's because someday, I WILL go to space for real.
